India to discuss Ganga Water Treaty via bilateral talks, says MEA

India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has stated that any discussions regarding the Ganga Water Treaty will be conducted through a bilateral mechanism. This decision indicates that the treaty's future talks will occur directly between India and Bangladesh, excluding multilateral forums. The MEA's announcement specifies the method for future engagements on the treaty.
